Acquire the specified extra fine trajectory batch to obtain at least eight rows; then compute z_t0 using shifted irregular-prefix times and fit the coupled dynamics numerically.

The observed endpoint-matched history gap and coupled transient lag indicate history-conditioned dynamics, not just endpoint difference.
